summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks about the fruits of vows, study, gifts, and duties; Bhishma explains that self-restraint and righteous conduct yield the highest spiritual rewards.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira sits beside the arrow‑pierced Bhishma on the battlefield, humbly asking about the rewards of vows, gifts, and righteous duties.
The aged Bhishma lying on his bed of arrows raises his hand in teaching while gathered kings and sages listen intently.
